snippet.title: The Snackbar at the End of the World | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Snackbar at the End of the World on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5211590?utm_source=RevealTrailerYT

A bittersweet story of love, defiance, and … pasta? As a chef in magical 1960s Italy you take over a struggling restaurant to save your family in this hand-drawn, narrative adventure RPG. Face explosive tomatoes, chaotic zucchini, and vendetta-driven poultry - then use them to cook the perfect dish.

Hi! *awkward wave* 

We’re the team behind The Snackbar at the End of the World and we’re here to keep you up-to-date on all the goings on in L’Ultima Citta:

Discord: https://discord.gg/jhFUysDz8y 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thesnackbarteam/  
X: https://x.com/thesnackbarteam 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thesnackbarteam 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/thesnackbarteam.bsky.social 
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/snackbar-studio 
Snackbar Studio website: https://snackbarstudio.com/
